correctness.rationale: The decic factors exactly as (x²+1)P_t1P_t2 for t1,t2 roots of T²+uT+v. Nonzero discriminant, v, and H(1) are necessary and sufficient for ten simple branch roots. Radical formulas identify the exact splitting field, quadratic-character signs and norm identities give the four possible Frobenius types. Independent character sums over F_q and F_q² count the coefficient pairs, and the even-subset representation gives Jac[2](F_q); odd cardinality ten rules out complement-swapped fixed classes. The algebraic steps establish all odd prime powers; independent checker verified 1282 prime-field pairs, 610 nonprime-field pairs, actual polynomial root degrees and all 8 torsion patterns. No finite sample is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: This is a complete natural coefficient-wise arithmetic classification of the ten hyperelliptic Weierstrass points in a two-dimensional genus-four family known for its exceptional Jacobian-square isogeny. The four-type theorem, 3(q²−1)/8 exact degree-four locus, and rational Jac[2] frequency distribution give information not implied by the known geometric isogeny or a single illustrative curve. The invariant and parameter domain are intrinsic to the motivating family; the precise classification serves questions of rational 2-division, splitting extensions, and finite-field arithmetic stratification.
